I'm also considering building 3 houses each on my light blue properties, costing $450 total and leaving $387 as a buffer, while noting P2's dark blues with houses carry heavy rents (Boardwalk $600, Park Place $500 at 2 houses) but hotels would cost $2000 against their $671.
